`pkg/controller/clusterautoscaler/clusterautoscaler.go`|Adds `featuregates` import, per-platform Cluster API FeatureGate name constants, and `--node-group-auto-discovery` arg constant.| |**Autoscaler argument construction**
`pkg/controller/clusterautoscaler/clusterautoscaler.go`|`AutoscalerArgs` now conditionally appends Cluster API autodiscovery flag and uses a helper to control `--enable-provisioning-requests`.| |**Feature-gate helper functions**
`pkg/controller/clusterautoscaler/clusterautoscaler.go`|Adds `isFeatureGateEnabled` and `shouldDisableClusterAPIProviderFor` helpers to safely evaluate feature gates and map platform → Cluster API FeatureGate.| |**Controller env var and pod spec updates**
`pkg/controller/clusterautoscaler/clusterautoscaler_controller.go`|Removes old `CAPIGroup`/`CAPIVersion` env entries, introduces `CAPIDisableEnvVar = "OPENSHIFT_CLUSTERAPI_DISABLE"`, and conditionally appends it with value `"true"` when Cluster API should be disabled for the platform.| |**Operator default cloud provider change**
`pkg/operator/config.go`|Updates `DefaultClusterAutoscalerCloudProvider` constant value from `"clusterapi"` to `"openshift"`, affecting NewConfig() defaults.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes
